# ContentLengthKnownBodyMismatch

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="native" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" />

Group: [Probable bugs](/rules/#probable-bugs)

Match Content-Length to the emitted bytes.

## Example

Finding:

```php{2}
<?php
header("Content-Length: 2"); echo "hello"; exit;
```

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 2: Match Content-Length to the emitted bytes.</li>
</ul>

## Detection

- Track effective literal Content-Length set by builtin header. Report that header when a complete straight-line local response path emits a statically known sequence of echo/print literal bytes and terminates, with total byte length unequal to the declared decimal length. Replacements override prior headers. Include final top-level path or a function ending in exit; do not treat returning from a helper as response completion. `exit` and `die` terminate the path in every spelling: bare, with an empty argument list (`exit()`, `die()`), which emits nothing, or with a string argument of known length, whose bytes count as body.
- Emit one finding per violating operation. Flow facts require a reachable path with no intervening mutation, escaped alias or unknown call involving the tracked value. When the proof is inconclusive, nothing is reported.

## Exceptions (no report)

- Unknown output, output buffering/handlers, zlib compression, includes, unknown calls, HEAD handling, 1xx/204/304 responses, transfer encoding and an `exit`/`die` argument of unknown length invalidate body-length proof. A configured SAPI transform cannot be assumed absent if evidence enables it.
- Exclude shadowed builtin symbols, unresolved required types, incomplete syntax and unsupported PHP versions.

## Fix

No automatic fix. Choosing a repair requires runtime information, error-handling policy or a semantic decision.

## PHP versions

Available throughout PHP 5.3–8.5.

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "ContentLengthKnownBodyMismatch": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file):

```php
// @custos-ignore ContentLengthKnownBodyMismatch
```
